server_profiles_collection.unique_index_status: unknown; PROJECT_B Track A skeleton route never assumed write

risk_matrix.scenario: flip new flag ON without seeding server_profiles — all users have NO active profile
risk_matrix.likelihood_today: only if we flip flag prematurely
risk_matrix.mitigation: forbid flag flip until seed/migration pack signed; current pack does NOT flip

risk_matrix.scenario: if dual-write missing and we switch UI to new endpoint, users.server stays stale
risk_matrix.likelihood_today: prevented (no dual-write currently; UI still uses legacy)
risk_matrix.mitigation: compatibility layer with dual-write/read-through to be designed BEFORE UI cutover

risk_matrix.scenario: player chooses server via legacy while migration seeds server_profiles — conflicting writes
risk_matrix.mitigation: lock /servers UI as read-only or hide from menu DURING migration window

risk_matrix.scenario: new endpoint has no capacity logic yet; future impl could allow over-capacity
risk_matrix.mitigation: reimplement capacity/maintenance/status checks in new contract before going live

risk_matrix.scenario: if users.server is migrated to server_profile_id and rollback is needed, reverse map required
risk_matrix.mitigation: future seed pack must include explicit rollback runbook with byte-identical inverse

risk_matrix.scenario: legacy POST requires auth via get_current_user; new POST currently has no auth wired
risk_matrix.mitigation: add auth dependency to new POST before flag flip

risk_matrix.scenario: if mobile client doesn't handle 503 gracefully on /api/server-profiles/select, UX breaks
risk_matrix.mitigation: frontend wrapper must treat 503 as 'feature_disabled' branch

dual_write_strategy_recommended.phase_1_seed: backfill server_profiles from users.server (1:1); idempotent; reversible
dual_write_strategy_recommended.phase_2_dual_write: new POST also writes users.server (and vice versa) behind compatibility flag
dual_write_strategy_recommended.phase_3_read_through: new GET reads server_profile_id; falls back to users.server
dual_write_strategy_recommended.phase_4_cutover: frontend switches to new endpoint; legacy kept as fallback for 1 release
dual_write_strategy_recommended.phase_5_deprecate: add HTTP 410/Sunset headers to legacy; remove after grace period

lock_recommendation_reason: prevent races and preserve users.server integrity during seed
risk_reason: Migration spans 5+ phases with player-visible consequences; cannot be performed without lock/preview UI and seed pack.
